basic_details.job_title: IISER Bhopal Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biological Sciences, Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal, has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Project Research Scientist-I post in an ICMR, New Delhi-funded research project, paying Rs. 56,000 per month (+ 20% HRA if applicable). The post needs an MSc in Biological Sciences with minimum 60% marks or CGPA 7.5 and above on a scale of 10, plus minimum 3 years of research experience, and candidates must be below 30 years of age at the time of application. Applications go only by email to [email protected] and must reach on or before 27 Nov

how_to_apply: Applications must reach the undersigned only by email, on and before 27 November 2026. Each application should contain a detailed CV with photograph and the names of two referees.
Send the email to Ram Kumar Mishra, Ph.D., at [email protected].
Postal address of the undersigned as printed: Room#119, Department of Biological Sciences, Academic Building-3, IISER Bhopal, Bhopal By-Pass Road, Bhauri, Bhopal 462066.
important_instructions: Only Indian nationals are invited to apply. Applications are accepted only by email; the notice asks that they reach the undersigned on and before 27 November 2026. The interview link goes only to shortlisted candidates.

ICMR, New Delhi, Government of India
1 year, extension up to 3 years possible upon satisfactory performance
Below 30 years of age at the time of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The essential qualification and experience for Project Research Scientist-I are given below. Experience: minimum 3 years of research experience is required. Age: candidates should be below 30 years of age at the time of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Preferably, having qualified CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or any other similar type national level exams. Candidates with prior experience in protein purification, ALS biology, mammalian cell culture and significant exposure to Drosophila genetics will be given preference.

rows.essential_qualification: MSc degree in Biological Sciences from a recognized University/Institute, with minimum 60% marks or CGPA of 7.5 and above on a scale of 10

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Rs. 56,000/- per month (+ 20% HRA if applicable). The duration is 1 year, but extension up to 3 years is possible upon satisfactory performance.
